mainEntity.name: What happens if I neglect maintenance after restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Neglecting maintenance after restoration can lead to a resurgence of the original problem or the development of new issues. For instance, unattended minor leaks can lead to mold, and neglected structural areas might weaken over time. This can result in more extensive and costly repairs down the line, potentially voiding warranties from the initial restoration.
